avis.titre: Thick, soft and a 'must have' after surgery
avis.texte: I have been using this for 4 weeks now, after major surgery. Everyone has commented how good my scar looks. Its so soft to apply, with no sting at all. I have recommended it to other people, who also love its results.
Crema perfetta utilizzo sia io che anche utilizzavo per cambio pannolino di mia figlia nel caso di arrossamenti, funziona davvero
